Tasks require understanding project structure, making changes consistent with language/tooling conventions, and passing tests in diverse ecosystems.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger and more difficult software engineering benchmark designed to be more industrially relevant and more resistant to shortcutting/contamination than earlier SWE-bench variants. Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory

Description: BrowseComp measures deep research and web-browsing competence by requiring models/agents to locate, synthesize, and justify answers using information from a controlled or specified web/document corpus. Cognitive Functions:
L1:

Description: τ2-bench evaluates interactive tool-using agents in realistic customer-service style scenarios (e.g., retail, airline, telecom) with policies, APIs, and multi-turn user simulation. L1: Visual Perception
